notes(nonPublishedName): This package is never published, but the nonPublishedName helps our ESLint package to find the top-level of mozilla-central
description: This package file is for node modules used in mozilla-central

scripts.linux-build: ./mach --no-interactive bootstrap --application-choice="Firefox for Desktop Artifact Mode" && ./mach build
scripts.linux-build-package: npm run linux-build && npm run linux-package
scripts.linux-build-run: npm run linux-build && npm run linux-run
scripts.android-build-run: npm run android-build && npm run android-build-apk && ./mach run --app=fenix
scripts.android-install-build: npm run android-build && npm run android-build-apk && ./mach android install-fenix
scripts.android-build-install: MOZCONFIG=objdir-frontend/.mozconfig npm run android-build && MOZCONFIG=objdir-frontend/.mozconfig npm run android-build-apk && npm run android-check-abi && npm run android-install-apk

notes(private): We don't want to publish to npm, so this is marked as private
